true_answer: All we need is some clear way of denoting the image of each element in the domain. In fact, writing a table of values would work perfectly: x 0 1 2 3 4 f ( x ) 3 3 2 4 1 We simplify this further by writing this as a matrix with each input directly over its output: f | ( 0 1 2 3 4 3 3 2 4 1 ) .
